# Zhou-Geng Xu (徐洲更)

Zhou-Geng Xu (Chinese: 徐洲更; also Zhougeng Xu; GitHub: xuzhougeng) is a postdoctoral fellow in Jia-Wei Wang's lab at the CAS Center for Excellence in Molecular Plant Sciences (CEMPS). He received a B.S. in Agronomy from Zhejiang A&F University (2012–2016) and a Ph.D. in Genetics from CEMPS / the University of Chinese Academy of Sciences (2016–2023). He has been a postdoctoral fellow at CEMPS since July 2023.

Research focus: plant single-cell sequencing and cross-species cell-atlas construction (scRNA-seq / snRNA-seq, ATAC-seq). Publications include Cell, Nature Communications, Nature Plants, Nature Methods, and Science. Related work was selected among the 2024 Top 10 Advances in Life Sciences in China.

Support: CAS Special Research Assistant Program; National Funded Postdoctoral Researcher Program (Category B); 2025 Postdoctoral Research Performance Evaluation Grant (First Tier).

ORCID: https://orcid.org/0000-0001-7682-3482

## Skills

- Plant single-cell omics: scRNA-seq / snRNA-seq, ATAC-seq, cross-species cell atlases
- Comparative genomics and gene-regulatory-network analysis
- Linux scientific computing: servers, Shell, R, Python
- Research software: desktop and web tool development
- Connecting large language models to literature, analysis, and research workflows

## AI for Science tools (by xuzhougeng)

- Wisp Science — open-source, local-first desktop AI research workbench: https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science
- CiteBox — AI literature manager and reading assistant: https://github.com/xuzhougeng/citebox
- WispTerm — AI-driven command-line terminal: https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wispterm

## Science communication

Since 2016 he has written bioinformatics tutorials covering Linux, transcriptomics, genome assembly, comparative genomics, and single-cell analysis. The blog 徐洲更的第二大脑 (xuzhougeng.com) has more than 290 posts and over 2 million reads. The early series Introduction to Transcriptomics has been widely republished in China. Zhihu column: hoptop的生信笔记 (2,000+ followers). Bilibili courses: about 100,000 views.
